item.title: OpenEMR 8.1.1 Release Notes
item.description:
DRAFT — based on rel-810 @ 0b5a720. Content regenerates on every push and is subject to change.

OpenEMR 8.1.1 — Release Notes

Features

  • #12647 feat(docker): declare HOST_UID/HOST_GID env in dev compose files — @bradymiller
  • #12642 feat(flex): honor HOST_UID/HOST_GID for apache uid alignment — @bradymiller
  • #12609 feat(docker): add fsupgrade-11.sh for 8.1.1 release (master sync) — @bradymiller
  • #12608 feat(docker): add fsupgrade-11.sh for 8.1.1 release on rel-810 — @bradymiller
  • #12603 feat(codes): Modernized DBAL/ORM service path for code type syncing — @Firehed
  • #12580 feat(ci): add byte-identical canary + config to FILES_ALL with context-aware diff logic — @bradymiller
  • #12577 feat(ci): auto-sync byte-identical files from master to rel branches — @bradymiller
  • #12539 feat(dx): Add REPL tool for dev envs — @Firehed
  • #12534 feat(insurance): client-side phone/fax validation on insurance + pharmacy edit forms — @bradymiller
  • #12481 feat(routing): Symfony-routing strangler seam for zend_modules — @kojiromike
  • #12484 feat(faxsms): encrypt unassigned inbound faxes at rest — @bradymiller
  • #12397 feat(ehi): extract (b)(10) EHI table set to b10-tables.yml — @kojiromike
  • #12267 feat(cli): refuse to run OpenEMR CLI as root — @bradymiller
  • #12335 feat(phpstan): SqlReservedWordRule + automated MySQL/MariaDB drift detection — @bradymiller

Bug Fixes

  • #12632 fix(docker): irp imports 0 patients because synthea output is in root-only /root/ — @bradymiller
  • #12547 fix(docker): checkout repo before flex build to dodge submodule recursion — @bradymiller
  • #12604 fix(ci): Restore Inferno after docker rearranging — @Firehed
  • #12597 fix(ci): docker-validate-release-targets reads master version.php from PR checkout — @bradymiller
  • #12594 fix(ci): sync-byte-identical handles rename + removed-from-config — @bradymiller
  • #12585 fix(ci): only require release-targets.yml in master context for byte-identical canary — @bradymiller
  • #12538 fix(insurance): clear phone_numbers before re-insert in legacy persist + cleanup migration — @bradymiller
  • #12570 fix(contrib): repair trailing comma in Pain_Initial_Assessment.json — @bradymiller
  • #12548 fix(docker): add php-posix to the flex image apk install list — @bradymiller
  • #12529 fix(persist): skip phones the legacy parts schema cannot represent (insurance + pharmacy) — @bradymiller
  • #12524 fix(deps): Harden dependencies by pulling in security meta-package — @Firehed
  • #12525 fix: prevent PHP 8 TypeError in Claim::payerCount() and procCount() — @rtmalikian
  • #12520 fix(calendar): restore appointments hidden after 8.0→8.1 upgrade — @kojiromike
  • #12519 fix(calendar): restore appointments hidden after 8.0→8.1 upgrade — @kojiromike
  • #12400 fix(reminders): Numerous bug fixes — @sjpadgett
  • #12473 fix(password): expired password warning not displaying — @stephenwaite
  • #12472 fix(ci): don’t run sql_upgrade as root in Inferno test — @Firehed
  • #12444 fix(calendar): allow save for timed In/Out of Office events — @bradymiller
  • #10989 fix(portal): block negative or zero patient payment amounts — @craigrallen
  • #12399 fix(fhir): make generated Observation value[x] PHPDoc nullable — @kojiromike
  • #12353 fix(payments): edit payment sql error — @stephenwaite
  • #12327 fix(oauth): use spec-compliant invalid_request error code (remove stray space) — @DucMinhNe
  • #12339 fix(payments): add cryptogen to front_payment.php — @stephenwaite
  • #12340 fix(sql): backtick bare system in ContactTelecomService for MySQL 8+ compat — @bradymiller

Refactoring

  • #12633 refactor(db): Move doctrine/migrations config — @Firehed
  • #12590 refactor(ci): relocate docker/compose.yml to .github/docker/ — @bradymiller
  • #12578 refactor(ci): extract sync-byte-identical bash into a tested script — @bradymiller
  • #12576 refactor(ci): trim docker/.gitignore + docker/COVERAGE.md from byte-identical set — @bradymiller
  • #12575 refactor(ci): externalize byte-identical FILES_ALL to a dedicated config file — @bradymiller
  • #12510 refactor(security): Remove unused client SSL certificate auth feature — @Firehed
  • #12435 refactor(calendar): migrate PostCalendar from Smarty to Twig — @bradymiller
  • #11521 refactor(portal): remove AngularJS from secure_chat and messages — @rollingventures
